## What changed

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Reference the task from the plan.

## How to check it

Give the reviewer the steps to try the change and record the checks actually run.

## Technical notes

Mention dependencies, shared interface changes, and known limitations when relevant.

## Before merge

- [ ] Relevant checks and privacy guard pass.
- [ ] Task handoff and affected docs are current.
- [ ] Shared interface changes have a decision line in the same commit.
- [ ] Review follows the team's agreed policy.
- [ ] The user explicitly approved merging this pull request.
